units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 10:32">Targ. Gen. X, 32</cite>; a. fr.—With suff. (pl.) <cite ref="B01393"><he>בַּתְרַי</he></cite>, <cite ref="B01393"><he>בַּתְרַאי</he></cite>, <he>בַּתְרָךְ</he> &c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 33:23">Targ. O. Ex. XXXIII, 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a:3">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite> spoke (evil) <he>ב׳ ערסי׳ דשמואל</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בַּתְרֵיה דמר שמואל</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) of Mar Samuel’s private life.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:9">Kidd. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>זיל ב׳ שתיקותא</he> follow the rule of silence; i.e. those of a peaceful nature are of pure descent.
<cite ref="Pesachim 84a:10">Pes. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ השתא אזלינן</he> we are guided by the present status.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:3">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>ליהוו למאן דבתרך וכ׳</he> let them (the presents) pass on to thy successors to be given to my successors that may come after thy death (as bribes to protect them).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:3:5">Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ</cite> which (opinion of) R. Meïr? <he>ההיא דתנינן לבתרה</he> that opinion of R. M. which is taught below; a. fr.
